# Ancient Indian Botanicals

Ancient Indian Botanicals Private Limited is an Indian B2B botanical sourcing and export-coordination company established in 2026, based in Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh. Udit Agrawal is the Managing Director and Manisha Agrawal is a Director.

## Product scope

- Botanical ingredients: whole, cut, powdered and selected extract grades
- Natural essential oils
- Aroma oils and fragrance accords, clearly identified separately from natural essential oils
- Carrier oils
- Hydrosols, floral waters and clays
- Seeds, nuts, makhana, coconut products, jaggery, millets and dehydrated food ingredients
- Cold-pressed and culinary oil routes, with intended grade confirmed per enquiry
- Sample, bulk and selected private-label packaging routes subject to confirmation

The website catalogue contains 129 consolidated product routes across botanicals, aromatic ingredients, seeds, nuts, dehydrated and value-added food ingredients, and cold-pressed oils. Availability, origin, composition, analytical specification, documentation, MOQ, pricing, packaging and lead time are confirmed only for the specific offered supplier lot and approved enquiry.

## Commercial process

Buyer requirement review, suitable supply-route identification, lot-document review, packaging confirmation, written quotation and export coordination.

- Selected essential-oil trial routes may begin at 25 kg; other MOQs are product- and pack-specific.
- FOB Nhava Sheva is a common starting quotation route; CFR, CIF or another Incoterm may be evaluated by destination.
- T/T is the normal starting payment route; a Letter of Credit may be considered for eligible larger or repeat orders.
- Specifications, COAs and supporting documents are shared privately against the proposed product or actual supplier lot where applicable.

## Important notices

Ancient Indian Botanicals Private Limited maintains GST, Udyam, IEC, APEDA RCMC, ICEGATE and ISO 9001:2015 credentials. Registration identifiers are supplied through verified quotations, tax invoices and commercial documents rather than reproduced in this public summary. Website content is for B2B commercial evaluation and is not medical advice. The website does not claim universal FSSAI, organic/NPOP, HACCP, laboratory accreditation or destination approval; evidence is confirmed for the relevant product, supplier lot and commercial route.
